sloka: इयं किल पुरी रम्या सुमालिप्रमुखैः पुरा ।भुक्तपूर्वा विशालाक्ष राक्षसैर्भीमविक्रमैः ।। ७.११.२९ ॥
transliteration: iyaṁ kila purī ramyā sumālipramukhaiḥ purā ।bhuktapūrvā viśālākṣa rākṣasairbhīmavikramaiḥ ।। 7.11.29 ॥

translations.english: O wide-eyed one, this beautiful city was indeed formerly inhabited by Rakshasas of terrible valor, led by Sumali and others.
